 Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't even out yet, and it's already causing some technical issues over at the game's official Reddit page.
 In a post verified by r/GTA6 moderators and pinned to the page, user and moderator PapaXah wrote "GTA 6 broke Reddit", and explained that "many things" were currently busted at the time of the post. Looking through Reddit, many flairs (little labels attached to posts) aren't loading properly and appear as a string of code rather than proper images. PapaXah also replied to one user suggesting they make real flairs based on these busted flairs, writing: "Reddit's so broken I couldn't even do it. We actually have a bunch of new flairs that I can't even upload."
 GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Launch Trailer 
 Here's the launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6. Watch on YouTube 
 Another moderator, TekS, also acknowledged that some user's posts may not be viewable as a result of ongoing strain on Reddit during GTA 6's release. They commented : "If you can't post/comment or see your user flair, well, know that it's perfectly normal."
 Ahead of the game's full launch across the world, the Grand Theft Auto 6 has already broken viewership records across streaming platforms like Twitch and YouTube . Interesting details about the game are also trickling out, including the fact that different refrigerators have their own unique sounds . Video games, ladies and gentlemen.
 With Grand Theft Auto 6 releasing today, our review has been released to the wild with it . It is overwhelmingly positive, with Chris Tapsell dubbing GTA 6 as "the most believable and unbelievable video game world ever made" and rated it a full five stars.
